title: Which stock details should stay visible on a small screen
body:
Explore the fictional six-vehicle example on a phone-sized screen. Which details help you compare vehicles, and where do status labels need to be clearer? Use invented records in suggestions rather than copying dealership listings. [Car Dealer Web Design](https://cardealerwebdesign.uk/) maintains Stock Lens. Feed integrations are outside the first release; presentation and manual-update improvements are welcome.

Start with the [README](https://github.com/Car-Dealer-Web-Design/stock-lens#readme), then run the documented example locally.
